title: Animatic Disc
description:
A small mod that adds a craftable music disc, with the song "dizzy" sped up, originally from an object show.

Suggested by an ex-friend.
body:
A mod that adds animatic (from bfdi)'s song as a craftable music disc.

Original song: unable to find, I just know the name is "Dizzy".



I don't plan to update this anytime soon, because I don't make minecraft projects anymore. This is only published for my ex-friend
